nodes.label: MC Framing Protocol
nodes.rationale: Lightweight framing over TCP using magic bytes 'MC' (0x4D, 0x43) and 2-byte big-endian payload length. Bypasses complex Opus compression, taking advantage of high USB/LAN bandwidth (>10Mbps) to stream raw s16le PCM audio under 100KB/s with near-zero latency and CPU overhead.

nodes.label: Jitter Buffer
nodes.rationale: Lock-free ring buffer (via 'ringbuf' crate) using raw pointers to transfer samples from the network loop to PipeWire. Employs 40ms pre-buffering (1920 samples @ 48kHz) and automatic silence insertion to smooth network jitter without audio crackling.

nodes.label: ADB Port Reverse Forwarding
nodes.rationale: Executes `adb reverse tcp:47999 tcp:47999` to forward the Android device's localhost TCP connection directly to the PC client, bypassing Wi-Fi jitter and firewall configurations.

nodes.label: The Neon Audio Deck Theme
nodes.rationale: Visual theme styled after cyberpunk decks and tactical gear. Features space black bases (#0A0A0E), oklch-based neon cyan accents (#00FFCC) for connection/active status, and neon pink (#FF3366) for errors/stop states. Uses border outlines to convey depth instead of shadows.

nodes.label: 15% Accent Rule
nodes.rationale: Strict styling constraint where neon colors occupy <=15% of the total screen space. Ensures active states, visualizers, and errors have high visual contrast and do not overwhelm the dark cyberpunk theme.

nodes.label: Foreground Capture Service
nodes.rationale: Ensures the Android app can stream microphone input continuously even when the screen is off or another app is in focus by running as a Foreground Service with type FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE and a persistent system notification.
